subject: Bespoke Azure SKU packaging for GreenWave — pricing & channel margin logistics
messages:
From: Anna Park <anna@greenwave.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@greenwave.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Bespoke SKU packaging for GreenWave private offer

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — product looked great. We are moving forward with a private offer on Azure but have a couple of twisty packaging items and need clarity on how the marketplace private offer will represent list price vs billing SKU for our reseller channel.

High level asks:
- Can you confirm whether we can map a single GreenWave "Platform" SKU to three underlying Azure SKUs (compute, storage, inference) in the private offer, while keeping the invoice as one line item?
- We need to show a 15–20% net margin to our reseller partners after list price pass-through; can Redwood provide recommended list-price to net passback mechanics?
- Any constraints on invoice routing (do you support distributor invoicing or must it flow via GreenWave)?

We have a tight procurement timeline — procurement team needs evidence of invoice pathing and a sample private-offer payload to present to finance by Jan 6. I attached the current procurement checklist.

Thanks,
Anna
Procurement Lead | GreenWave AI
attachments: GreenWave_requirements.docx (docx)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Park <anna@greenwave.ai>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@greenwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Bespoke SKU packaging for GreenWave private offer

Anna — thanks for the clear outline. Looping in Ben for channel pricing and Irene for marketplace ops/legal items. Quick answers up front:
- You can present a single consolidated invoice line while the private offer maps to multiple underlying SKUs; we'll need the SKU mapping table and the metering semantics to make the private-offer payload correct.
- We typically recommend modeling pass-through as list-price anchoring with a reseller "passback" line item. Ben, attaching the procurement checklist you can use — can you draft three margin scenarios (15%, 20%, 25%) with both list-price and net-back views?
- Invoice routing: Redwood supports both direct-customer invoicing and distributor-invoice paths depending on the marketplace and partner setup; Irene, can you confirm Azure's acceptable paths for channel-billed private offers and whether there's a region limitation?

Action items / timeline:
1) Ben: margin scenarios + example private-offer JSON by EOD Dec 31 (attachment: pricing-template-v2.xlsx)
2) Irene: confirm invoice routing + required evidence (SOC2, reseller agreement) by Jan 3
3) Anna/ProcureOps: confirm final SKU mapping and preferred invoicing path by Jan 4 so we can produce the DocuSign/private-offer draft by Jan 6

I'll assemble a short mutual action plan once we have the pieces.

— Stephanie
Senior Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
attachments: pricing-template-v2.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Anna Park <anna@greenwave.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 31 Dec 2027 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Bespoke SKU packaging for GreenWave private offer

Stephanie / Anna — attached a concise channel-margin scenarios doc. Summary:
- Scenario A (list-price anchor): list price = $100k, reseller passback 20% -> net to reseller 20k; Redwood recommends setting the private-offer visible price to the aggregated list price and using an internal passback ledger for partner payouts.
- Scenario B (net-first with surcharge): lower visible list price, explicit reseller surcharge line on invoice — cleaner for distributor routing but increases accounting complexity.
- Scenario C (hybrid): invoice single line to customer; reseller receives monthly settlement CSV with passback calculation.

Key notes:
- If GreenWave requires distributors to invoice (i.e., distributor pays Redwood), Azure restricts some distributor billing flows — Irene can confirm.
- For your 15–20% target, Scenario A at 20% is simplest operationally; Scenario B hits 15% but requires distributor reconciliation.

Attached: channel-margin-scenarios.pdf (pdf) and a filled pricing-template-v2.xlsx with toy numbers.

Let me know which scenario you want us to formalize for the private-offer payload.

Cheers,
Ben
Head of Channel Pricing | Redwood Inference
attachments: channel-margin-scenarios.pdf (pdf), pricing-template-v2.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Park <anna@greenwave.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Jan 2028 09:26:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Bespoke SKU packaging for GreenWave private offer

Hi all — quick follow from Marketplace ops/legal:

- Azure supports a consolidated-line private offer (single invoice line) that maps to multiple SKUs, but there are two constraints to call out: 1) Distributor invoicing requires the distributor to be set up as a "Reseller of Record" in Azure — that adds a registration lead time (typically 7–10 business days), and 2) Invoice routing for tax/regulatory reasons may require localized legal entities in certain countries (not an issue for US).
- Evidence: ProcureOps will want SOC2 Type II and a reseller agreement template. We can provide SOC2 link and a sample reseller-ops addendum.
- For the private-offer JSON payload, we need the SKU mapping table and the metering unit (e.g., node-hours, GB-month, inference-token). Connor, can you prepare the sample payload structure for Anna to review?

Irene
Principal, Marketplace Operations | Redwood Inference
attachments: redlines-private-offer.docx (docx)
From: ProcureOps <procureops@greenwave.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@greenwave.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 Jan 2028 09:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Bespoke SKU packaging for GreenWave private offer — evidence + invoice routing questions

Irene / Stephanie — thanks. A few clarifying questions from procurement:
1) Can Redwood deliver a sample invoice PDF that reflects Scenario A (list-price anchor) and shows the reseller passback as a separate settlement line not visible to the customer? We need to show this to our finance team.
2) If we set distributor as Reseller of Record, will Redwood still be able to attach usage reports (CSV) back to GreenWave for settlement?
3) Is there any additional marketplace fee (publisher/seller fee) that reduces the gross available for passback?

Please attach the SOC2 Type II link and reseller addendum to your reply. Our deadline for evidence is EOD Jan 6.

– ProcureOps (on behalf of GreenWave finance)
attachments: GreenWave_requirements.docx (docx)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: ProcureOps <procureops@greenwave.ai>, Anna Park <anna@greenwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 Jan 2028 15:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Bespoke SKU packaging for GreenWave private offer — evidence + invoice routing questions

ProcureOps / Anna — summarized responses and next steps:

1) Sample invoice: Attached is a redacted sample invoice that mirrors Scenario A — single customer-visible line, with an internal settlement CSV exported monthly to GreenWave showing the 20% reseller passback calculation. (attachment: sample-invoice-scenarioA.pdf)
2) Distributor as Reseller of Record: yes, supported. Redwood will emit usage files and a settlement CSV to the party you nominate (GreenWave or distributor). The reseller-of-record setup will require the distributor's Azure reseller ID and a short registration step (Irene can start this once you confirm the distributor).
3) Marketplace fees: Azure takes the marketplace listing fee (varies by region). Redwood's standard practice is to show gross list price and deduct marketplace fees in our settlement; those fees reduce the pool available for passback — Ben has modelled this in the attached channel-margin scenarios.

Attachments included: channel-margin-scenarios.pdf (redacted), pricing-template-v2.xlsx (filled), redlines-private-offer.docx, sample-invoice-scenarioA.pdf

Next steps:
- Anna: confirm final SKU mapping + preferred distributor (if any) by EOD Jan 6.
- Connor: please finalize the private-offer JSON payload and the DocuSign-ready statement of work once Anna confirms — target Jan 9 for DocuSign prep.

Thanks everyone — we're on track to have the private-offer ready for GreenWave procurement review.

— Stephanie
Senior Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
